And so on – until you’ve found yourself again in any kind of present moment. This might take some time! You will find that it is not easy to stay with the activity but rather your mind wants all sorts things like “I want this” or ” I don’t need this.”
The first thing you have got yourself off from reality and into thoughts about what could be better for me. After that, there may also come some feelings which seem to express themselves as “I want more” or ” I don’t need any of it.”
